missing: A side-by-side list of 1 kWh stations that really take about 1,000 W of solar through two inputs (e.g. DELTA 3 Plus and its rivals), with measured refill times from 0–100%, per-input voltage/current limits, the panel setups needed to reach that ceiling, and current prices.
why: No major reviewer or authority answers this question. TechRadar's two pages cover a 2 kWh unit capped at 400 W and a tiny power bank. Jackery's pages show 400 W to 800 W limits, not 1,000 W. The only page that answers it is Volt & Valley, a niche site that names the DELTA 3 Plus from published specs, without its own testing, and its estimate is about three hours, not two. Four results returned no text. A focused page that compares 1 kWh units with dual inputs on combined solar input, measured refill time and current price would stand out.
